senses.gloss: to be startled; נ׳ לאחוריו to be startled and move backward, to start back.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Parah 3:3">Par. III, 3</cite>. Y. R. Hash. II, beg. 57ᵈ <he>ונִרְתַּעְתִּי לאחוריי</he> I started back (was astonished); (Tosef. ib. I, 15 <he>נבעתתי ונפלתי</he>); Bab.
R. Hash. 22ᵇ ונרתעתי ונפלתי (Ms. M. 2 והתרעתי, read: והִרְתַּעְתִּי Hif.); a. fr.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="T01142">same</cite>. Y. Ber. III, 6ᵈ bot. <he>וה׳ מלפניו כמַרְתִּיעַ וכ׳</he> and he shrank back from it, as one shrinks from a serpent.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 12">Num. R. s. 12<sup>3</sup></cite> <he>שלשה … וה׳ לאחוריו</he> three things did Moses hear by which he was startled (puzzled); a. e.

senses.gloss: (cmp. רָתַח) to be excited; (of a serpent) to hiss.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 10:7">Gen. R. s. 10</cite> <he>ראה נחש מַרְתִּיעַ ובא</he> saw a serpent coming on in excitement; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 22">Lev. R. s. 22</cite>. Y. Ber. V, 9ᵃ bot. <he>אבל היה מרתיע ובא כנגדו</he> but if the serpent comes against him in excitement, opp. <he>כרוך</he>; a. e.

<cite ref="Shabbat 55b:10">Sabb. 55ᵇ</cite> (play on <he>פ̇ח̇ז̇</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 49:4">Gen. XLIX, 4</cite>) <he>ז̇עזעתה הִירְ֗תַּעְתָּהּ פ̇רח̇ה וכ׳</he> thou didst scare her, thou didst frighten her away, and sin flew from thee.
